statements: Of the 197 accepted cells, I individually reviewed 51 using the source images.
For the remaining 146, I explicitly instructed you to bulk-accept the AI-drafted annotations, rather than inspecting every cell individually.

policy.individual: Only exported accepted/corrected per-cell decisions count as individually human reviewed.
policy.bulk: Previously AI visually cross-checked and bulk user-approved; not independently human verified.
policy.structure: Headers, periods, roles, units, hierarchy, geometry and completeness remain unreviewed.
policy.labels: Preserve the prior 98-label user attestation; there are no exported individual label-review decisions, so do not report individually verified label accuracy.
policy.preserve: Keep original export, v1 decisions and ledger unchanged; this clarification supersedes their previous confidence labels.
